messages.subject: Executive application | Minerals processing, sustainability and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Golden Lime Human Resources Team,

I am submitting my executive profile through your published Job Opportunity channel after my earlier introduction to Investor Relations was rejected by my email provider before delivery.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership scope spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation.

Golden Lime’s minerals-processing platform aligns closely with my experience. I bring direct operating-side understanding of regulator expectations, community relationships, sustainability execution and the coordination needed to convert external commitments into accountable action across technical and corporate teams. My recent work also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery infrastructure and carbon-data readiness.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional leadership mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, ESG, Strategic Partnerships or Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available following a 30-day notice period.

My attached CV is tailored to Golden Lime. I would value a confidential discussion with the relevant senior HR or business leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
